R531.note: instance.full_clean()+save() correctly triggers validate_file_content; auto_now_add's implicit blank=True lets clean_fields skip uploaded_at, so no side effects.

R532.note: html.escape() blocks classic <script>/attribute XSS but doesn't touch { } so Jinja template syntax in query.term still executes when render_template_string() parses the concatenated string - wrong shape for this sink; should pass term as a template variable to use Jinja's own autoescaping instead.

R533.note: Session write moved after login_user(); untrusted cart id only lands in an authenticated session, no other behavior changed.

R534.note: Math.multiplyExact() closes the overflow and the catch returns 400 as required; valid non-overflowing combinations still return allocated length as text, matching the stated contract.

R535.note: Primary fix shown (allowed_classes=>false) makes unserialize() return a non-ShoppingCart value, so the existing instanceof check on line 23 always fails and every previously-set cart cookie silently resets to empty; the working whitelist variant is offered only as an aside ('you may instead'), not flagged as required to preserve legitimate cart restore.

R536.note: Wildcard moved into the bound parameter value; LIKE '%term%' semantics and injection-safety both preserved per the stated contract.

R537.note: json_encode with HEX flags correctly replaces the manually-quoted JS string literal (quotes removed from the literal since json_encode supplies its own); preserves legitimate note text.

R538.note: Allowlisted function-registry approach correctly eliminates arbitrary code execution; openly discloses that this replaces free-form scripts with fixed function names, which necessarily breaks existing script-based clients (unavoidable and disclosed for CWE-94). Minor: the reverse() lambda uses Reverse()/ToArray() without a shown 'using System.Linq;'.

R539.note: Tika content-sniffing + ImageIO re-encode + UUID filename correctly matches the stated contract, but the fully-reproduced AvatarController.java 'Fixed Code' drops 'import java.io.IOException;' while keeping 'throws IOException' and a catch(IOException) block (the sibling AvatarStorage.java fix keeps this import), so as written it would not compile.

R540.note: Removing [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] restores the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter; no other behavior touched.

R541.note: RandomNumberGenerator replaces seeded System.Random; token generation is now unpredictable and unrelated to the (now-ignored) seed query param, which is the intended fix.

R542.note: Removing the no-op SignatureValidator restores default cryptographic signature verification; legitimate signed tokens are unaffected, only forged/unsigned tokens (the vulnerability itself) are now rejected.

R543.note: noent:false/dtdload:false disables entity substitution and external DTD loading in libxmljs, the documented fix for this library's XXE-prone defaults; ordinary order XML without a DOCTYPE parses unchanged.

R544.note: secure_filename() plus an extension whitelist closes both the path-traversal and dangerous-extension angles the verdict identified; the UUID-prefixed filename changes the returned path format, but this is stated plainly and a valid path is still returned to the caller.

R545.note: isolated-vm's ExternalCopy only supports structured-cloneable data (objects, arrays, primitives, etc.), not functions; wrapping the emit callback in new ExternalCopy(fn).copy() is the wrong API for exposing a callback (should use a Reference / {reference:true}) and would throw during context setup, silently breaking order-flagging for every legitimate script rather than only blocking malicious ones - the write-up claims the same emit API surface is preserved, which is not disclosed as broken.

R546.note: Gate::authorize() throws and halts execution on denial, the idiomatic Laravel enforcement call; authorized updates proceed exactly as before.

R547.note: Encode.forHtml() is the correct context-appropriate encoder for the HTML body sink; default 'there' and ordinary names render unchanged.

R548.note: Sensitive error detail moved to server-side slog logging; client now gets a fixed generic message, success path unchanged.

R549.note: node-serialize has no safe subset (unlike allowed_classes/ObjectInputFilter equivalents), so replacing the wire format with JSON+Ajv is the right call, and the write-up explicitly discloses the breaking change: existing node-serialize cookies fail to parse and silently reset to an empty profile until reissued.
